detaileddescription.para: This constant maps to the XPAR parameter created in the xparameters.h file. It is defined here so that you can easily change all the needed parameters in one place.

briefdescription.para: Illustrates how to use the SFL library with SPI, QSPI, or OSPI flash.
Demonstrates erase, write, and read with the serial flash library.

detaileddescription.para: This file contains a design example using the serial flash library (SFL). The hardware on which this example runs must have an octal serial NOR flash.
This example has been tested with the Micron Octal Serial Flash (MT35XU02GCBA).
